review_scope: Technical review of 23 matched physical-inventory views after preserving the dry shower stream basis. The prologue matrix and title Continue cases are separate.

images.observation: The boiler gauge, casing and overhead pipes are separately legible.
Shelf divisions, door trim and floor grain remain visible in the room view.
Tile joints terminate cleanly at the vent casing and trim.
The same dark masonry fills the frame. It gives limited hatch coverage.
The hall fixtures and floorboards read under the same warm falloff.
The lamp spot reads on the tile courses beside the curtain and service set.
Glazing and floor reflectance retain separation from the furnishings and resident.
Floorboards, table and window frame are distinct under the room lamp.
The hood, basin and stained rendered wall retain readable boundaries.
The opened cover, fuse cores and wall conduit are individually visible.
The under-counter composition remains dark. The rail and tile grid are readable but the pet detail is limited.
The cat and its shelf are visible against the muted green wall.
The red timber underside and upright shelf silhouette hold in the same low-angle view.
Mail slots and handles remain separate from the dark wall and bench.
The fin edges, sill and blind slats remain distinct around the window.
The open drive cage, rails and floor retain clean silhouettes and separate finishes.
The tank and steel supports remain distinct against the adjacent rooftops.
The terminal case, desk and board retain their separation under the fixture.
The light tile courses and cistern finish hold in the confined view.
The colored flowing deposit remains visible over the boards beside the radiator.
The red vertical surface stays legible against the radiator and the lamp spot.
Crumbs and counter grain remain visible around the kettle and toaster.
The brass dial and case edge remain discernible on the dark wall.
